bug_description.original:
Detailed Report: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5926030899150848

Project: uwebsockets
Fuzzing Engine: libFuzzer
Fuzz Target: TopicTree
Job Type: libfuzzer_ubsan_uwebsockets
Platform Id: linux

Crash Type: Index-out-of-bounds
Crash Address: 
Crash State:
  uWS::TopicTree::publish
  uWS::TopicTree::publish
  uWS::TopicTree::publish
  
Sanitizer: undefined (UBSAN)
bug_description.normalized: The staged witness reaches the TopicTree publish operation with an attacker-controlled topic string. In vulnerable `uWS::TopicTree::publish`, the fixed-capacity `triggeredTopics[64]` array is drained only once at function entry. During the same publish chain, recursive calls through wildcard children and additions of terminating wildcard children can keep increasing `numTriggeredTopics`. If those earlier additions bring `numTriggeredTopics` to 64 before the final exact-match topic is queued, line 163 still executes `triggeredTopics[numTriggeredTopics++] = iterator;` without a local capacity check, producing the saved UBSan `index 64 out of bounds for type 'uWS::Topic *[64]'`. The patch moves the drain guard to each append site, showing that every enqueue must revalidate capacity rather than relying on the one entry check.

source.description: First project statement on the vulnerable path that consumes attacker-controlled bytes as the topic string for the recursive publish operation.
source.value_from: Within the chunk callback, `lastString` is first materialized from fuzz bytes by `std::string_view lastString((char *) data + 5, size - 5);` at line 37, and this publish call is the first project-code statement that uses that attacker-controlled topic on the crashing path. The libFuzzer entry itself is only a harness boundary.

root_cause.description: The exact-match enqueue uses `numTriggeredTopics` as an array index with no capacity recheck at the append site, even though earlier wildcard-related appends in the same publish chain may already have raised the count to 64.
root_cause.note: The fix inserts `if (numTriggeredTopics == 64) { drain(); }` immediately before this statement and before the analogous terminating-wildcard append, confirming the missing per-enqueue capacity check in vulnerable code.

sink.description: When `numTriggeredTopics` has already reached 64, this write indexes `triggeredTopics[64]` even though the valid indices of the fixed array are 0 through 63.
sink.note: Stage 01's saved UBSan trace records `runtime error: index 64 out of bounds for type 'uWS::Topic *[64]'` at `../src/TopicTree.h:163:13` with repeated `uWS::TopicTree::publish` frames.

parser_admitted.description: The staged input is admitted into the publish branch of the TopicTree fuzz grammar rather than taking subscribe, unsubscribe, unsubscribe-all, or drain actions.

tainted_value_origin.description: The chunk parser materializes bytes 5..end of the attacker-controlled chunk as `lastString`, which then drives TopicTree publish traversal and matching.

coarse_trace.summary: The fuzz chunk callback materializes `lastString` from attacker bytes and, for a `'P'` action with non-empty data, calls `topicTree.publish(lastString, {lastString, lastString})`.
The recursive publisher performs a single capacity guard on entry, then walks topic segments while wildcard recursion and terminating-wildcard matches can append topics into `triggeredTopics[64]`.
After earlier appends in the same publish chain bring `numTriggeredTopics` to 64, the exact-match enqueue still writes `triggeredTopics[64]`, matching the saved UBSan index-out-of-bounds report.

fine_trace.note: Source. In the `'P'` branch with non-empty `lastString`, attacker-controlled bytes are consumed as the topic string for `TopicTree::publish`.

The vulnerable function performs its only capacity guard before traversing the topic. The call continues when entry-state `numTriggeredTopics` is below 64, even though later operations in the same publish chain can enqueue additional topics.

When the current node has a wildcard child, `publish` recurses before the exact-match enqueue. The saved stack contains repeated `uWS::TopicTree::publish` frames at line 146, showing this recursive path on the witness.

Each visited node with a terminating wildcard child can append another topic to `triggeredTopics`. In the vulnerable source this append also lacks a local capacity recheck, so these additions can keep increasing `numTriggeredTopics` after the one entry guard has been passed.

After recursion and terminating-wildcard processing, the exact-match topic reaches its enqueue branch when it has not yet been marked triggered. By this point, earlier wildcard-related appends in the same publish chain may already have raised `numTriggeredTopics` to 64.

Root cause and sink. The exact-match enqueue uses the current `numTriggeredTopics` directly as an array index without a fresh capacity check. On the saved witness, UBSan reports that this statement evaluates index 64 for `Topic *[64]`.

cross_validation.sink_matches_crash: Yes. The saved crash trace reports `runtime error: index 64 out of bounds for type 'uWS::Topic *[64]'` at `/src/uWebSockets/src/TopicTree.h:163:51`, matching fine-trace step 6.
cross_validation.trace_consistent_with_stack: Yes. The repeated `uWS::TopicTree::publish` frames at line 146 align with the recursive wildcard path in step 3, and the top crashing frame at line 163 aligns with the unchecked exact-match enqueue in step 6.
cross_validation.tainted_value_reaches_sink: Yes. Attacker bytes become `lastString` in the chunk parser, that topic is published in step 1, governs recursive traversal and wildcard-trigger additions in steps 3 and 4, and the resulting `numTriggeredTopics` state is consumed by the out-of-bounds index at step 6.

poc.trigger: Stage 01's saved vulnerable run reproduced `UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer: undefined-behavior ../src/TopicTree.h:163:13` with `runtime error: index 64 out of bounds for type 'uWS::Topic *[64]'` while running the `TopicTree` fuzz target on the staged `poc`.

format.name: TopicTree fuzz chunk stream
format.contract: The witnessed input must contain a chunk sequence that first builds a TopicTree state with enough distinct wildcard-related topics to increase `numTriggeredTopics` during one publish chain, then reaches the `'P'` branch with a non-empty publish topic whose traversal causes those earlier wildcard-related additions to bring `numTriggeredTopics` to exactly 64 before the final exact-match enqueue at `src/TopicTree.h:163`. The staged evidence proves this accepted publish path for the supplied `poc`; it does not establish a broader trigger class beyond inputs that realize that same source-level state transition.

evidence_limitations: The staged artifacts do not decode the PoC into its exact chunk sequence or topic strings, so the precise wildcard layout and the exact distribution of the 64 triggered topics are inferred from the vulnerable source, patch, and saved recursive crash stack rather than directly enumerated from witness bytes.

Stage 02 remained source-grounded and did not rerun the PoC, instrument `numTriggeredTopics`, or perform vulnerable/fixed differential execution; executable validation is limited here to the saved Stage 01 reproduction report and UBSan trace.
